item.title: Create A Holistic Strategy for Hospitals
item.description: Our understanding of health has greatly evolved. As providers continue to adopt a whole-person health approach to care delivery, they may consider turning that lens on their own systems. item.title: HIMSS26: Clarifying Governance for Ambient Clinical Documentation Tools
item.description: A patient walks into a doctor’s office and, for 15 minutes, shares detailed, personal information with her clinician. item.title: HIMSS26: What Health Systems Need To Know About Microsoft Dragon Copilot
item.description: Documentation overload, clinical burnout and rising operational costs are just some of the challenges healthcare organizations face today.
